fields.note: Field screen only. Not a clearance. Evidence package is with the agent. — Luis

original.subject: Orchard Standpipe
original.body:
Mr. Ferreira,

The Ohio National Guard civil support team’s field screen of the jug and the residue found no radiological reading and was negative for the common pesticides it can test for. The jug, caps and residue are going to an FBI-approved laboratory; expect results in about 48 hours.

Your advisory decision is yours to make; we do not recommend one way or the other.

Please preserve the CAM-13 footage and the RTU-02 event logs and send copies with a chain-of-custody record.

WMD Coordinator

instructorNote: “Not detected by field screen” is not “safe”. Watch that it does not change the advisory.

snapshot.title: FBI: Site Security Confirmed — No Further Tampering

fields.subject: FW: Orchard Standpipe Site Security Confirmation
fields.note: This is the FBI Cyber Forensics Unit’s initial forensic assessment of the Orchard Standpipe site. All evidence has been preserved and is under federal jurisdiction. No further tampering has occurred since the scene was secured. All future access to the site, RTU-02, MBW-NVR-01, or any related systems must be coordinated through the FBI liaison. We are now beginning full forensic analysis of the historian trends, HMI audit logs, and PACS session recordings from MBW-SCADA-SRV01 and MBW-FW-01. Please confirm receipt and maintain chain of custody.
fields.signature:
FBI Cyber Forensics Unit
Field Office, Chicago
Contact: (555) 034-1101 (secure line)

original.subject: Orchard Standpipe Site Security Confirmation
original.body: The FBI has completed the initial forensic assessment of the Orchard Standpipe site. No further tampering has occurred. The video from CAM-13 and RTU-02 event logs have been preserved and are not to be altered or overwritten for 30 days. The site is secure and under federal jurisdiction. All future evidence handling must be coordinated through the FBI liaison (555-034-1101). The forensic team is now conducting a full analysis of the historian trends, HMI audit logs, and PACS session recordings from MBW-SCADA-SRV01 and MBW-FW-01. All system access must remain blocked until further notice. This is a federal investigation.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the FBI's control over the scene and evidence. The Security Officer must acknowledge receipt and enforce the no-access directive. Watch for any attempt to bypass FBI authority or initiate local system checks.
